features.claim: It was very long, with an estimated body length between about 11 and 15 metres.
features.quote: It has an estimated body length between 10.9–15.2 m (36–50 ft), making it the largest known madtsoiid.

features.claim: Its body may have been longer than Titanoboa's.
features.quote: Although the vertebral dimensions of Vasuki are slightly smaller than those of Titanoboa (estimated at 12.8 m (42 ft) ± 2.2 m (7 ft 3 in)), the upper length estimates indicate a longer body for the former.

features.claim: It was one of the longest snakes ever found.
features.quote: The highest length estimates place Vasuki among the longest snakes ever discovered.

debated.claim: Its length is not settled: one method gives about 11 to 12 metres and another gives about 14.5 to 15 metres.
debated.quote: The former equation resulted in a body length range of 10.9–12.2 m (36–40 ft), while the latter equation resulted in a body length range of 14.5–15.2 m (48–50 ft).

second_reading.claim: It was not a crocodile, even though early work on the fossils suggested that.
